extras: The README includes detailed release management scripts.
intentEvidence: IAL adds Pandoc-style Inline Attribute Lists to Obsidian, enabling custom IDs, classes, and attributes directly in Markdown.
problem: Standard Markdown lacks native support for adding custom attributes like IDs or classes directly within the text using Pandoc-style syntax.
summary: Adds Pandoc-style Inline Attribute Lists (IAL) to Obsidian Markdown, enabling custom IDs, classes, and attributes directly within notes.
